items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that can wash the chest and shoulders without adding anything unsuitable for breastfeeding.

response.routine_note: Wash the chest and shoulders once or twice a day, rinse well, and shower soon after sweating. I have held back on the exfoliating spray and the other actives because you are breastfeeding, so please ask a pharmacist or doctor which spot products are suitable for you, especially for skin your baby may touch.
